verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete. The workflow keeps PR-authored fuzz execution in a read-only job with checkout credentials disabled, while the write-scoped filing job is reachable only after failed randomized schedule or push-to-main runs and executes trusted main-branch code. Artifact transfer and missing-log handling preserve failure reporting. The replay guard fails closed for empty or absent replay inputs, exempts randomized mode, and has non-vacuous hermetic coverage. Untrusted fuzz output is fence-defused both when read and at the rendering boundary, with round-trip tests covering fence escape attempts and idempotence. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is evident. Compared with round 1, there are still no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
